name: azure
title: Azure architecture
description: Cloud architecture diagrams with Azure service icons and boundaries (region, subscription, resource group, VNet, subnet).

flow.description: Request or data flow from source to target. Label with protocol/purpose (e.g. 'HTTPS', 'AMQP', 'SQL').

async_flow.description: Asynchronous messaging/event flow from producer (source) to consumer (target).

dependency.description: Source depends on/reads configuration or secrets from target (e.g. app -> Key Vault).

private_connection.description: Private Link / private endpoint connectivity from consumer (source) to service (target).

network_link.description: Network connectivity without a direction (peering, VPN, ExpressRoute).

replication.description: Data replication between source and target (geo-replication, sync).

monitoring.description: Telemetry/logs sent from source to a monitoring target (Monitor, Log Analytics, Sentinel).
